placements.why: The envelope introduces an operational category governing the systematic calibration and verification of observatory instrumentation against reference baselines.
placements.title: Establishing Empirical Standards for Observatory Instrument Verification
placements.frame: How does the observatory govern, record, and verify the operational calibration standards for its scientific instruments across observing cycles?

placements.why: The segments jointly assert the operating frequency and verification of the Kestrelwood spectrograph against June reference plates across its full observing band, providing evidence for empirical baseline instrument verification.
placements.title: Grounding Spectrographic Calibration in Empirical Reference Plates
placements.frame: How are active instrument calibrations verified against historical baseline reference plates to ensure performance holds across the full observing band?
